milestones.description: Plan: 'Ignoble Hierarch and Ancient Tomb accelerate Food Chain out early' — Ignoble Hierarch on turn 1.
Plan: 'resolve Food Chain' accelerated 'out early' — Food Chain cast by turn 3.
Plan: 'resolve Food Chain, then loop a creature that can be cast from exile — Squee, the Immortal' — both pieces visible in hand/board/yard (exile is not visible in the prompt).
Plan: 'Pour that mana into a payoff: Walking Ballista for lethal, or a Goblin-Matron-fetched Sling-Gang Lieutenant / Broadside Bombardiers chain' — Food Chain first, payoff later.
Plan: 'Goblin Matron find the missing piece' — rate Matron is cast when offered.
Plan: 'Once Upon a Time and Goblin Matron find the missing piece' — rate Once Upon a Time is cast when offered.
Plan: 'Walking Ballista for lethal, or ... Sling-Gang Lieutenant / Broadside Bombardiers ... for reach' — a payoff ever cast.

notes: Squee recast from exile is invisible to the zone scan (exile is not in the prompt); engine_assembled therefore under-counts mid-combo states. Documented limitation.
fixtures_note: no logged games for this archetype yet; extractors covered by synthetic fixtures in test_plan_adherence.py
